mentions.name: partijgedrag
mentions.description: Partijgedrag pulls public Dutch parliamentary motion votings and processes them to give people better insight into how Dutch political parties vote. It includes a voting compass, which gets busy around elections. Originally created by Erwin and being continued by the author, who hopes other countries may enjoy similar functionality.
mentions.audience: People seeking better insight into how Dutch parties vote; with hopes of expanding to other countries
mentions.source_excerpt: I pull public motion votings and do any kind of processing I want to give people a better insight in how the Dutch parties vote. There's a voting compass that gets a bit busy before elections.
